definitions.explanation: Environmental harm caused by industrial or human activity that affects public health and living conditions. A key term in Japanese environmental history, especially regarding the pollution crises of the 1960s-70s.

examples.japanese: {公害|こうがい}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧だ。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{公害|こうがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Wastewater from the factory became the cause of pollution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{成長期|せいちょうき}→成長期：21342_seichouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{公害|こうがい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧し⟦{社会問題|しゃかいもんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧になった。
examples.english: During the period of rapid economic growth, pollution occurred in various regions and became a social issue.

notes:
A central concept in modern Japanese history. Japan's rapid industrialization in the 1960s led to severe pollution incidents known as the {四大公害病|よんだいこうがいびょう} (four major pollution-related diseases), including Minamata disease and Itai-itai disease.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公害|こうがい}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (pollution problem)
- {公害|こうがい}{病|びょう} (pollution-related disease)
- {公害|こうがい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (pollution countermeasures)
- {公害|こうがい}⟦{訴訟|そしょう}→訴訟：07642_soshou⟧ (pollution lawsuit)

USAGE:
{公害|こうがい} specifically refers to pollution that harms public welfare, distinguishing it from general ⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧ (contamination). It has a legal dimension in Japan — the {公害対策基本法|こうがいたいさくきほんほう} (Basic Law for Environmental Pollution Control) was enacted in 1967.
